Has tree cover changed? Not detectably so far.
Compared with the earlier period, the difference is smaller than the normal swing from year to year.
Same colour scale on both maps. Ground heat is estimated and gap-filled: it ranks areas, it is not an exact reading.
A satellite greenness estimate, not a tree count.
Different clear days and seasons feed each period.
Same place, three methods: see the bars.

The journey: what a client does in about a minute
The map opens with the top sites
Move a slider, e.g. care more
re-order at once; a short note
Click a marker or a list row.
The site card says why in one
change; here is how sure we are.
States to design (wording matters more than looks)
"Loading Elmina data..." with the map frame visible, so
Site card shows: "Click a site to see why it ranks here."
A one-time hint points at the map.
"No sites match these filters." with a Clear filters
Says what happened, gives the start command, offers
Unmissable banner: this is invented sample data, do not
Amber note until the ML model is connected; a clear
notice if its file is rejected or out of date.
